data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 阳伞下的不悦侧目
data.description: 王室避暑海滩的阳伞阴凉下。阿蕾克希亚坐在条纹沙滩巾上，双手环胸别扭地别过脸去，银色马尾随动作轻摆，余光却狠狠瞪着旁边那个装作若无其事的凡人仆从波奇。
data.location: shaded beach cabana with striped sun lounger and sunny ocean background
data.action: sitting with arms crossed on a beach towel, head turned away with a sharp pout, casting a sideways scowl full of proud irritation
data.lighting: bright beach sunlight diffused softly beneath a canvas cabana canopy
data.mood: tsundere pride, hidden vulnerability, sharp royal edge
data.promptProse: Alexia in a red bikini sits with arms crossed under a beach umbrella, pouting and scowling sideways at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Alexia glaring sideways with crossed arms under a beach umbrella.
